items.p1: All payments will be through Paypal.
items.p2: Any additional charges (rush fee, added details, futher edits, NDA) will be upheld and respected by all parties involved.

items.p1: Changing references is allowed if we haven't started on your commission. Please ask first.
items.p2: Major revisions can be made during the Sketch phase only.
items.p3: After approval of the sketch (during lineart of color phase) major revisions/edits may be subject to a 'edit fee'.
items.p4: If you require approval for every stage of the work (sketch > lineart > color > shading) please let me know.
items.p5: No major changes are allowed in the finishing stage that will affect the composition of the artwork.

items.p1: 1. If I find that these terms are violated, the one who committed the violation will be blacklisted and won't be able to commission again in the future.
items.p2: 2. In the event of a chargeback for any form of extortion; we may publish the offender's relevant social media, PayPal email and business-related exchanges (such as emails and invoices) as proof of breaking our ToS. Personal information such as addesses will be redacted.
